description: This CSS file contains styles for a Tic Tac Toe game frontend application, defining styles for the app layout, game board, squares, buttons, and responsive design adjustments.

classes.name: app
classes.description: The main container for the Tic Tac Toe application, setting layout properties.

classes.name: status
classes.description: Styles the status message display in the application.

classes.name: board
classes.description: Defines the grid layout for the Tic Tac Toe game board.

classes.name: square
classes.description: Styles individual squares of the Tic Tac Toe game board.

classes.name: reset-button
classes.description: Styles the reset button for restarting the game.
